title: Task Doc
description: Edges Task document contract. CLI frontmatter and a board item's optional doc align to this shape. Metadata keys mirror extensions/clis task frontmatter. Unknown metadata keys are allowed. body is Markdown, not precompiled HTML.

name.description: Frontmatter name. Not the Task stem and not metadata.edges-title.

edges-title.description: Display title. Board title falls back to name, then the Task stem.

edges-task-project.description: Task Project id. Omit when default (directory _default). Value default is allowed. Not a status folder and not the directory name _default.

edges-task-priority.description: Orthogonal to edges-tasks-status. Omitted on new files when none; absent reads as none.
